items.title: Astronauts Among Us
items.creator: Entity Builds
items.description:
Our brave explorers have been troubled by mischief within their ranks. They’ve travelled to space, past the stars to distant planets but are still working to discover what or who has been causing chaos on their ship. Travel the cosmos and unravel the mysteries of the universe, but watch out, the lights are going out and Blue is missing. 

~Cute Astronauts
~Mystery Roleplay

items.title: Spring Luxury Teens
items.creator: Atheris Games
items.description:
Spring's here! Are you ready to become free as flower power? Feel the spring and enjoy this new skin pack. Enjoy unique luxury clothes among teens binge-watching anime all day long. Get ready to equip the latest pieces in fashion! Be the fanciest bee!

+ By Atheris Games

items.title: Lucky Block Varsity

- Cute and fun

items.title: Safest Skyblock Base
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Upgrade your skyblock experience with this safest skyblock base map! The base is protected with lava, lasers, security cameras and much more!

- Lasers, automated doors, cameras, custom lava bridge for extra security
- Teleport room to teleport to other islands
- Movie theater
- Swimming pool
- Farms
- Disco
- Surrounding islands

items.title: Parkour Life
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Jump, flip, and tumble! It's time to run around as fast as you can and be the fastest teen in the city! Parkour is what they specialize in and they will never stop to take over the whole world. Join the fun and shout your hearts out with modern fashion! Be a parkour pro and show off your skills to your friends!

+ 12 teen skins!
+ City jumpers!
+ Perfect for roleplay!!

items.title: Neon Hackers

- 1 free neon hacker skin
- 6 full HD layered skins

items.title: Neon Robots - Infinity
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
With a single glowing eye, you’ll be quite a colorful computerized creature. Bright and brilliant, light up the night in Neon Robots skins. Role-play with friends and shine all day in electric blue, yellow, red, or pink. Show up at school as a radiant cyborg and impress all the students. Walk around the city and dazzle all of Minecraft. 

+ 8 fluorescent bot HD skins

items.title: Vikings vs Knights
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Conquer or defend when you role-play with friends in Vikings vs. Knights skins. Sail in from the North in a longship, ready to take over all the Minecraft land you can seize. Swords, long hair, and beards give you the strength to challenge noble knights. In helmet and armor, draw a long sword and be brave protecting your kingdom.

+ 8 dueling warrior HD skins

items.title: Ninja Heroes
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Summon the power of dragons and serpents to save the city with Ninja Heroes skins. Gear up in colorful ninja armor and sharp swords to role-play with friends as good spies keeping your neighbors safe and sound. Use ropes, hooks, and tools on your belt to get to places where you can keep watch while you keep hidden. Arigato, ninja hero.

+ 8 sly and secret HD skins

items.title: Parkour Tower
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Parkour Tower takes you on an amazing journey through 18 levels. Can you complete the parkour and reach the top of the tower? Challenge your skills!

- Different unique levels!
- Parkour that is fun for everyone!
- Multiplayer friendly!
- Leader boards & replay-ability!
- Custom mechanics and challenges!
- Jump, booster, snake blocks & more!

items.title: ONE BLOCK SKYBLOCK
items.creator: SNDBX
items.description:
One Block Skyblock is like skyblock, but only for the pros. In this world you get ONE BLOCK, and that’s it. Do you think you have what it takes to survive and build an epic base?

+ Play in the Overworld, Nether and End
+ 3 unique difficulties
+ Over 200 block outcomes

We wish you luck in possibly the most challenging gamemode to date.
